name: OIDC-Auth
description: Advanced OIDC authentication with role-based library access control
overview: OpenID Connect SSO with granular role-to-library mapping, multi-provider support, and a full admin configuration UI.
changelog: BREAKING: requires Jellyfin 12.0 or newer. Retargeted to .NET 10 and Jellyfin.Controller 12.0.0; removed IAuthenticationProvider.HasPassword, dropped from the interface in 12.0. Jellyfin 10.10/10.11 servers must stay on 0.1.11.x. No functional changes to the OIDC/SAML login, RBAC, or back-channel logout flows.
